# Digital Kings

> Engineering-grade AI automation, digital marketing, and custom web development — built by a software engineer with 10 years of experience.

Digital Kings is a digital growth agency founded by a software engineer with a decade of experience building production systems. Unlike traditional marketing agencies, every service is built on engineering principles: systematic, measurable, and automated where possible.

## Services

- **AI Automation**: Custom n8n workflows, LLM integrations, CRM automation, and intelligent lead systems
- **Digital Marketing**: Paid advertising (Google Ads, Meta Ads), SEO, email campaigns, and analytics
- **Custom Web Development**: Full-stack Next.js websites — no templates, no page builders
- **Social Media Management**: Strategy, content, and data-driven optimisation

## Why Digital Kings

The founder spent 10 years building software systems — architectures, automation pipelines, and full-stack applications. That engineering mindset applies directly to marketing: every campaign is a system, every decision is data-driven, and every client gets direct access to the person doing the work.
